title: Deadlock prevention with lock ordering
summary: Acquire both account locks in a consistent order so opposite transfers cannot form a wait cycle.
triggers: prevent deadlock when updating two shared objects
prompts: Move funds between two accounts while other threads may transfer in either direction.
Handle a transfer to the same account without acquiring a non-reentrant lock twice.
invariant: Every transfer between distinct accounts acquires the locks in increasing object identity order and checks funds while holding both.
mantra: Sort the locks; keep the business direction.
pitfalls: Acquiring the source lock first creates a cycle when two transfers run in opposite directions.
Checking funds before locking lets two transfers spend the same balance.
Object identity is a lock rank within one process; it is not a persistent account ID.

mutations.explanation: A transfer equal to the balance should succeed; only an overdraft is rejected.

test: assert not worker.is_alive(), "Transfer did not finish"
